common.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
common.ignore: If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for {storeName}
verifyEmail.preview: One step to activate your account.
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Thanks for signing up. Select the button below to confirm your email address and activate your account.
verifyEmail.expiry: This link expires in one hour.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link for {storeName}
magicLink.heading: Your sign-in link
magicLink.body: Select the button below to sign in to your account. The link can be used only once.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your {storeName} password
resetPassword.preview: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account. Select the button below to choose a new password. You will be signed out on all other devices.
resetPassword.expiry: This link expires in one hour.

receipt.subject: Your receipt for order {number} at {storeName}
receipt.preview: Your products are ready in My Purchases.
receipt.heading: Thank you for your purchase
receipt.body: Your payment was received and your products are ready in My Purchases.
receipt.security: For your security, downloads are available only from your account.

changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new email for {storeName}
changeEmail.preview: Confirm the new address for your account.
changeEmail.heading: Confirm your new email
changeEmail.body: You asked to use this address for your account. Select the button below to confirm it; until then your account keeps its current email.
changeEmail.expiry: This link expires in one hour.
